features.statement: Header is a single bar with the logo on the left and navigation links right-aligned.
Hero is a full-bleed image with white text over a darkened overlay.
Small uppercase letter-spaced eyebrow labels sit above section headings.
Opening statement is pulled out as a large serif lead paragraph, with remaining copy in two columns.
Pairs an elegant display serif for headings with a clean sans-serif for body text.
Headings are very large and bold, with a dramatic scale jump over slightly smaller body text.
Warm cream page background with blush pink and dark plum colored bands.
Primary buttons are fully rounded pills in saturated pink.
Testimonials appear as a row of three white cards with gold star ratings and a small serif signature at the bottom.
Testimonials use semantic figure, blockquote and figcaption markup.
Post listings are clean divider-separated rows with the title left and author right.
Split panel pairs a photo on one side with a dark colored text panel on the other.
Social feed is a tidy grid of rounded gradient tiles with serif captions.
Social links are plain underlined text links with small labels instead of brand-colored blocks.
Footer is dark with multiple columns, sentence-case serif headings and small muted left-aligned legal text.
Uses real, descriptively alt-texted photographs as img elements for key imagery.
Cards use soft shadows, mid-size corner radii and gradient fills for depth.
Uses semantic elements like address and linked phone numbers, with a clean low-weight DOM.
Layout built with CSS grid alongside flex, producing a compact, shorter page.
Calls-to-action are phrased as whole-sentence bold links ending in an arrow.
Nav labels and titles are short and concise.
